_note: citycov3 (16 Nov 2026): the OFFICIAL Dhaka Metropolitan Area bus fare chart of the Dhaka Metropolitan Regional Transport Committee (RTC) / BRTA, issued under the fare notification of 31 Aug 2022 (scanned charts dated Sep-Dec 2022; published on brta.gov.bd). Per route: the government route number, every stop in order and the official distance in km from the first stop. Facts only (stop order + distances) taken from the government document; the text was read from the scanned PDF pages via the public transcription at github.com/imamhossain94/dhaka-metro-area-bus-fare-list and spot-checked by us against the PDF page images (Piloting Route-1, 16 Nov 2026). The chart is from 2022: a route that no second public source confirms stays Reported; distances give the Official fare (current BRTA per-km rate x official km).

source.s: BRTA / Dhaka RTC official bus fare chart (2022)
